newsitem.title: IRAQ: France's Jany Le Pen to visit Iraq - papers.
newsitem.headline: France's Jany Le Pen to visit Iraq - papers.

text.p: Jany Le Pen, wife of the leader of France's right-wing National Front party, Jean-Marie Le Pen, will arrive in Iraq on Saturday to present medical supplies, Iraqi newspapers said on Wednesday.
"She ... will present more than two tonnes of medical supplies and an ambulance to Iraqi hospitals," the official al-Iraq daily said.
Iraq is under United Nations trade sanctions imposed on it after its invasion of Kuwait in 1990. Baghdad says thousands of people have died because of shortages of medicine.
In December the U.N. allowed Iraq to start selling sell $2 billion of its oil to buy food and medicine. The first medical shipment reached the country earlier this week.
Jany Le Pen and her husband visited Iraq last year and met President Saddam Hussein.
